t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Kinniwerelani namona, Kho Mulukwaka, wera wi Nyuwo Mokipatusha wi miyo Nyuwo Kosuweleni ni wokokhorani Kinnilapa mwa chuhu yela ethu yohiwereya mene ikuru sanyu, muthonyero aka ni muhakhwanya. Khavovo Muluku Mukina opwaha Nyuwo, okikhunela mu sawopiha yowo onikhala Mwa yowo Mekhaiye.
